claims.description: An empty list causes the existing deterministic safe fallback.

claim_text.description: One factual claim to render only when its literal text is a non-empty substring of supporting_excerpt.

evidence_handle.description: Exactly one server-issued handle from the selected evidence supplied to this request.

supporting_excerpt.description: A non-empty exact substring copied from the evidence item referenced by evidence_handle; claim_text must be a literal substring of this value.
